methods: Independent schema, locale, source-file, registry identity and pattern validation
Deterministic registry and strict pedagogy verification

checks.name: exact lesson, block and pattern sets
checks.evidence: Seven requested slugs; 10 canonical blocks per lesson; lessonId/packageId/patternIds match the current registry; 20 total and 20 unique patterns.

checks.name: source resolution
checks.evidence: All block sourceRefIds resolve in their lesson catalog; all 35 locator file portions exist; worked and marking references resolve.

checks.name: nested bilingual learner content
checks.evidence: Content, worked requirement/design/trace/output/test expectations, practice fixtures/hints/reveal/feedback/rubrics, retrieval and marking fields carry substantive vi/en values. Technical code and identifiers remain language-neutral.

checks.name: worked example chain
checks.evidence: All seven lessons provide requirement, design, Python, trace, expected output, normal/boundary/failure tests and evidence; prior independent isolated executions exited 0.

checks.name: practice, retrieval and marking chain
checks.evidence: Every lesson has guided/faded/independent practice with fixture, expected artifact, hint, reveal, misconception repair and authored rubric; retrieval includes hidden answer, reveal, diagnosis, repair and self-rubric; marking uses AlgoCore_authored_rubric and forbids invented official marks.

checks.name: testing zero-pattern static fallback
checks.evidence: testing/action-view remains mode=static-conceptual with empty patternIds and no runtime controls/events. Its localized staticTable has four explicit columns and three representative rows labeled Normal, Boundary and Failure trace in both VI and EN.

checks.name: deterministic verification
checks.evidence: Current registry contains 26 lessons and 260 canonical blocks; strict pedagogy verifier reports zero required findings.

closed_findings.evidence: Localized positive staticTable now contains explicit fixture, expected, actual and verdict columns plus Normal, Boundary and Failure trace rows; pattern ownership remains empty and no runtime controls/events were introduced.

gate_rule: PASS requires zero open GATE findings.
